name: Flavours of Forest Restaurant (Asiatic Lion Lodge)
why_it_matters: Closest verified Kathiyawadi sit-down to the Sasan Gir safari gate (~5 km) — the in-house restaurant at Asiatic Lion Lodge with a documented 70% on-farm vegetable claim. The default morning-after-safari thali option for Gir NP visitors not staying inside the gate cluster.
insider_tip: After the morning 6 AM safari, the 11.30 AM-1 PM brunch slot here is the best timed meal — kitchen is on the lunch sequence and you can rest before the afternoon safari. Call ahead.
signature_address: Asiatic Lion Lodge, Sasan Gir, Gir Somnath District 362135

name: Aaranya Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Self-described 'best resort in Gir National Park with authentic Kathiyawadi food' on its own site, listed on Justdial + MakeMyTrip with consistent dining footprint. Sits on Bhojade Road near the safari approach — convenient for groups staying at the resort itself rather than driving in from Veraval.
insider_tip: Walk-in possible if the resort has lunch capacity — call 30 minutes ahead. Pool-side garden seating is the late-afternoon pick before evening safari.
signature_address: Aaranya Resort, Bhojade Road, Sasan, Gir 362135

name: Jagira Ananta Elite Restaurant
why_it_matters: Jagira Ananta Elite is one of the few proper 5-star options in Gir — its in-house patio multi-cuisine restaurant serves Chinese, Indian and Italian, with a buffet breakfast that pads safari-day mornings. Sits in Chitrod cluster, north of Sasan village.
insider_tip: Buffet breakfast 7-10 AM is the standout meal — fills you for the day given safari schedules. Italian and Chinese are competent fallback dinners; for Kathiyawadi specifically, walk to Aaranya or Asiatic Lion Lodge.
signature_address: Jagira Ananta Elite, Chitrod, Sasan Gir, Gir Somnath District 362135

name: The Fern Gir Forest Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The Fern Gir Forest Resort is one of the most-booked stays in the Gir circuit (A Fern Crown Collection property) with an eco-resort positioning. The in-house multi-cuisine restaurant serves all-day, with the Gujarati thali as the most-recommended dish per restaurant-guru aggregations.
insider_tip: Spa-day buffet (when running) is the best value — bundled rates. Outside guests welcome but call ahead, especially in safari peak season (Nov-Feb).
signature_address: The Fern Gir Forest Resort, SH-26 Sasan Road, Sasangir, Gir National Park, Junagadh 362135
